description: This Java source file defines a REST API resource for managing client family members within the Apache Fineract platform. It includes endpoints for retrieving, adding, updating, and deleting family member data for clients, utilizing Jakarta REST annotations and integrating with Fineract's security and command services.

classes.name: ClientFamilyMembersApiResource
classes.description: A REST API resource class exposing endpoints for managing client family members, including CRUD operations and retrieving templates. It handles authorization, serialization, and command dispatching within the Fineract platform.

methods.name: getFamilyMember
methods.description: Retrieves a specific family member's data for a given client ID, after validating read permissions.

methods.name: getFamilyMembers
methods.description: Retrieves the list of all family members associated with a specific client ID.

methods.name: getTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for creating or updating family member data.

methods.name: updateClientFamilyMembers
methods.description: Updates a specified family member's information for a client, based on provided JSON data.

methods.name: addClientFamilyMembers
methods.description: Adds a new family member to a client using data from the request payload.

methods.name: deleteClientFamilyMembers
methods.description: Deletes a specified family member from a client record.
